assets.prompt: Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a polished wide landscape 16:9 explanatory image for a GitHub README about MiniMax H3 cloud video production. This is a visual process illustration, not a sample video result. Editorial design with warm ivory paper background, deep midnight teal objects, amber highlights, clear fine directional arrows, tasteful physical miniature models and generous spacing. Language-neutral so it can accompany Chinese, English, Japanese and Korean pages. Only permitted written text: the small heading "MiniMax H3" and large step numbers "01", "02", "03", "04". Do not render any other text or gibberish labels. Four equally important scenes laid out in an easily followed clockwise loop: top-left 01, a personal cloud GPU server tower with a small cloud and an owned-workspace key symbol; top-right 02, multiple film contact sheets showing varied cinematic compositions of one consistent original amber paper bird in a teal paper architectural set, illustrating repeated generation experiments; bottom-right 03, a human hand curating three successful frames into a consistent visual reference binder with palette swatches and camera sketches, illustrating human review and accumulated style decisions; bottom-left 04, an elegant continuous strip of film frames depicting that consistent bird in different purposeful close-up/wide/overhead shots with common color, materials and lighting, illustrating reusable personal style. Strong arrows 01→02→03→04 and a subtle return arrow 04→02. Each numbered scene is distinct and not crowded. No training brain, neural-network evolution, measured success charts, price claims, provider logos, people portraits or fake UI. Readable at 800 pixels wide, integrated publication-quality image, crisp rendering, not a busy dashboard.

Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a second polished wide landscape 16:9 explanatory image for the same MiniMax H3 GitHub README. A clear three-stage left-to-right workflow with three wide visual stations on an ivory paper background. Same art direction throughout: midnight teal, warm amber, subtle paper textures, finely modeled miniature objects, editorial diagram composition, generous margins. Only text allowed: heading "MiniMax H3", and the numbers "01", "02", "03". No other letters, prices, sentences, logos or fake UI. Station 01 at left: a transcript sheet with abstract gray lines and time ticks, two visual reference swatches, and a small director's plan containing three camera compositions. Station 02 center: a very clear storyboard of EXACTLY four panels arranged in a 2x2 grid, all depicting an original amber paper bird moving through a teal geometric miniature landscape; next to it three separate clean keyframe cards extracted from those panels; small human-approval checkmark medallion below the storyboard. Station 03 right: a compact cloud GPU server connected to independent finished video clip cards, a download symbol and a folder, visually showing cloud generation and file delivery. Large restrained amber arrows connect 01→02→03. A small checkmark at the first transition represents user approval of the shot plan; the storyboard station may show two small checkmarks for sample and full-board approval, but no fake approval text. The cloud has a single production lane, not a complex mesh. Storyboard grid must be 2x2, never 2x3 or 3x3. Make the process comprehensible without reading text; this is a conceptual workflow illustration, no claimed H3 output screenshots. Clear and beautiful at GitHub README widths.
